title: Alternating series: the even partial sum is <= the next (odd-length) partial sum
statement: For a : Nat -> CReal with every a k >= 0: for every k, sumRange (fun i => (-1)^i * a i) (2k) <= sumRange (fun i => (-1)^i * a i) (2k+1) -- the even-index partial sum E(k) is at most the very next partial sum O(k), the E <= O half of the Leibniz alternating-series bracket, using only nonnegativity of the terms (not monotonicity).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.alternatingELeO : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal.le CReal.zero (x0 x1))) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (CReal.sumRange (fun (x3 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x3) (x0 x3)) (AxNat.add x2 x2)) (CReal.sumRange (fun (x3 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x3) (x0 x3)) (AxNat.succ (AxNat.add x2 x2))))))

evidence.supports: CReal.alternatingELeO is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
